description: Generation-Boundary Manifest. Classifies copilot job types against this platform's data contract. Integrators building the Trainer Copilot must not implement 'forbidden' jobs against this contract, and must gate 'composition_adjacent' jobs behind mandatory human review.

pure_retrieval.detail: Answer trainer questions by returning exact fields from the canonical content JSON, always citing the field's provenance (table caption + doc version). Refuse with 'Not yet authorized in the source manual' when the field is pending.
Return Malay/English pairs from the glossary and roster tables verbatim.
Return a drill's Structure of Command grid verbatim (introductory/cautionary/pause/executionary rows, tones, syllable splits).
Assemble the Common Faults bullets for a drill (optionally per stage) verbatim, grouped by stage. Formatting only; no rewording.
Given a squad size, return the manual's matching layout/ratio rows for the documented bands (<=24, >24). Sizes outside documented bands must be flagged as undocumented, never extrapolated.
Report per-drill content_status, missing tables, and pending figure slots from the manifest.

composition_adjacent_requires_human_revi.detail: Sequencing sourced tables against trainer-supplied context (squad size, time available). Every output line must be tagged manual-sourced vs trainer-supplied/composed.
Strictly templated counts-only summaries of logged fault data. No causal language, no diagnosis, no severity judgments beyond counts.

forbidden.detail: Composing new technique-cue wording, new commands, new tempo/timing values, or any physical-execution guidance not verbatim in the sourced fields.
Composing quiz questions or multiple-choice distractors. Assessment items must be SME-authored and approved as their own content type with provenance.
Answering from general knowledge, other militaries' drill standards, or inference when the sourced field is pending or absent.
Generating or sourcing stand-in imagery, audio, or video for pending figure slots. Only approved uploads fulfil figure slots.
